name: Droidmap Nmap command templates
description: Command templates matching NmapRunner.java. Execute argv directly with ProcessBuilder; do not concatenate a shell command.

binary.description: Absolute path to the packaged Nmap executable.

dataDir.description: Absolute path to the installed Nmap databases and NSE files.

libraryDir.description: Parent directory of binary, used as LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

host.description: Validated single local IP literal, without the IPv6 %interface suffix.

interface.description: Validated interface scope extracted from an IPv6 zone, for example wlan0.

ports.description: Comma-separated TCP ports verified OPEN for this device by the initial scan or advertised endpoint checks.

openPorts.description: Comma-separated TCP ports confirmed open by the preceding Nmap service scan.

timeoutMs.description: Configured timeout clamped to 100–3000 ms before substitution.

conditionalArgumentGroups.when: IPv6 target has an explicit interface zone

execution.argumentOrder: binary, applicable conditional argument groups in listed order, profile argv
execution.cancellation: Terminate the active process and stop its output reader.

serviceDetection.description: TCP connect scanning with lightweight service/version detection.

vulnerabilityDetection.description: Detect services on confirmed-open TCP ports, then let NSE port/service rules choose applicable safe-category vulnerability scripts, including services on nonstandard ports.
vulnerabilityDetection.requires: Successful preceding service detection with at least one Nmap-confirmed open port.
argv: (vuln and safe) and not brute and not dos and not intrusive and not exploit

selection.eligibleDevices: Every found device with verified-open TCP ports from initial or advertised endpoint checks. No Fast/Complete host-count limit.
selection.order: Verified-open check order, with duplicate hosts and ports removed. Devices are processed sequentially.
selection.notices: Report per-target failures, cancellations and completed service enrichments.
